purpose: Authoritative source candidates for conditional Transaction Command Center evidence. Discovery does not imply a completed search, clearance, legal conclusion, or property-specific match.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP Well Permits & Records
statewide_sources.semantics: NJDEP states it maintains well permits, well records and well decommissioning reports statewide. Property documentation may require DataMiner or an Individual Well Search request. This is not septic-system clearance.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP Known Contaminated Sites / DataMiner
statewide_sources.semantics: Match by subject address or Program Interest number. Preserve NJDEP active, pending and closed case semantics. Nearby sites are context only and must not be attributed to the subject parcel.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP Heating Oil Tank / UST Records
statewide_sources.semantics: Use NJDEP UHOT/UST and Site Remediation records for subject-property evidence. An NJDEP remediation case can support follow-up but does not by itself prove a currently installed tank.

statewide_sources.label: NJ DCA Bureau of Housing Inspection Service Portal
statewide_sources.semantics: The portal exposes properties on file with Housing Inspection and may provide inspection reports, registration/inspection certificates and judgments. Local rental licensing and municipal requirements remain separate.

statewide_sources.label: NJ DCA Lead-Based Paint Inspection Program
statewide_sources.semantics: Use for statewide program rules and municipality inspection method. A property-specific valid lead-safe certificate or exemption requires authoritative property/municipal evidence.

statewide_sources.label: NJDEP Gas Utilities Territory Map
statewide_sources.semantics: Identifies likely natural-gas utility territory only. It cannot establish whether the property has service, an open account, a balance, shutoff status, or final utility clearance.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: Official county Surrogate source by county.
provider_families.semantics: Do not infer death, estate status or probate involvement from names or ownership changes. Use only authorized party information or an authoritative case/document match.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: Official county Sheriff and NJ Judiciary sources by county/case.
provider_families.semantics: Require a parcel, docket or verified party match. A similarly named party is not sufficient.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: Official municipal zoning/planning records and searchable board/permit systems where available.
provider_families.semantics: A zoning map classification is not proof that the present use or improvements are lawful or that all conditions were satisfied.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: Official municipal rental/code/housing source where applicable, reconciled with NJ DCA Housing Inspection data.
provider_families.semantics: Requirements vary by municipality and building type. Missing source coverage must remain unknown, not not-required.

provider_families.discovery_strategy: County/local health department or municipal health records where authoritative property-level records exist.
provider_families.semantics: No universal statewide property-level septic clearance source is assumed. Well records and septic records are separate evidence families.
